composition_variation: Create an original high-quality 2D anime illustration of one beautiful 26-year-old adult woman with youthful adult vitality and a mature, self-assured presence. Design clear amber eyes, a softly rounded adult face, defined lips, and a gentle, interested smile. Her berry-red hair ends curve inward at the shoulders. She wears an opaque ivory sleeveless blouse with a high neat neckline, loose dusty-rose cropped trousers, and flat cloth shoes. Beside a small courtyard table, she lifts a modest ceramic vase with both hands at mid-torso, considering a single plum branch already inside it. The vase is simple and light enough to hold naturally. A pale plaster wall, a low timber door, and delicate blossoms form the setting. Use ivory, dusty rose, berry red, and subdued celadon, with soft springlike light rendered as a pleasant summer garden morning and subtle shadows beneath the leaves. Use an eye-level camera and a calm three-quarter-length portrait. Place her centrally in the middle and lower frame, entirely inside a narrow phone-safe composition; keep hands close to her torso. Reserve the upper 25% as uncluttered light atmosphere for the lock-screen clock. Natural anatomy, opaque clothing, no text, no logos, no additional people.
